symptoms: pain radiating into other areas of the body, especially the legs
spine-related leg pain (sciatica or radicular pain)
diagnosis: comprehensive clinical assessment comprising a careful physical examination
imaging tests (e.g., X-rays, CT scans, MRI scans)
blood tests to rule out underlying diseases
complications: loss of work and retirement wealth
key_facts: 619 million people live with LBP worldwide
LBP is the leading cause of disability worldwide
LBP is a major public health issue
LBP affects people of all ages, including children and adolescents
